body:
## Sub-issue of #853 — Part 1: i18n core, registry and catalogue reader

**Proposal, asking for a yes before any code lands.** Follow-up to the closure of #3304.

### What

Land the language infrastructure only:

- `crates/i18n` — a dependency-free catalogue crate: `Lang` descriptor, `REGISTRY`, `"English source" = "translation"` parser, `tr()/tr_in()/count()` lookup, locale-tag parsing, coverage report and tests.
- `assets/i18n/README.md` and `scripts/i18n/check.py` — translator workflow; the checker needs no build.
- `assets/i18n/zh-CN.toml` — shipped as data, 3,638 strings, 0 errors from the checker.
- `docs/I18N.md` and `docs/decisions/853-ui-translations.md` — design, measurements, and what deliberately stays untranslated.
- `Cargo.toml` — workspace member and dependency wiring.

### Why this part first

The crate has no dependencies and no call sites. It can be reviewed on its own and gives the later font and UI parts a stable seam. The catalogue is included here only because `Lang::ZhCn` uses `include_str!` and the crate's coverage test reads it; no UI text is routed through it yet.

### Not in this part

No font, no picker, no preference, no `tr()` call sites. Posted G-code, CL, project files, `.mch`/`.cps`, MCP names and JSON, parsed log lines and test goldens stay byte-identical.

### Acceptance

- `python3 scripts/i18n/check.py assets/i18n/zh-CN.toml` exits 0 with 3,638 strings.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-i18n` passes; a missing translation degrades to English, never to a key.
- No change to any user-visible string in the app.

### Depends on

#853 priority decision (the umbrella is `P?`). Part 2 and Part 3 depend on this part.
